title: Adding a Power BI workspace to Company Information to be used when deploying reports
summary: Company Information now supports configuring a Power BI Workspace to serve as the target destination for deploying Power BI reports from Business Central.
key_points: Added a Power BI Workspace field to Company Information's Reporting section
Workspace configuration is used as the deployment target for Deployable reports
New method surfaces added to Power BI service interfaces to support workspace management
Workspace lookup page added to allow selecting from available Power BI workspaces
Changes applied across all localization layers (W1, NA, GB, DE, FR, etc.)
